title: Builders in Purasawalkam: Shared Walls, Tight Streets, Old Stock

seo.metaTitle: Builders in Purasawalkam | House Rebuilds | Hunter Property
seo.metaDescription: Rebuilding on a tight Purasawalkam street? We assess shared walls with a structural engineer, check permitted use and plan hand-carried access before quoting.

excerpt: Purasawalkam has some of Chennai’s oldest building stock, shared walls and streets too narrow for a car. This guide covers party walls, access, mixed-use plots and building upward on a small site.
faqTitle: Building in Purasawalkam: questions owners ask

faqs.question: What do your house construction packages cost in Purasawalkam?
faqs.answer: Our packages are priced per sq ft of built-up area: Basic ₹2,199, Standard ₹2,399, Premium ₹2,699 and Ultra Luxury ₹3,199. Approvals, soil test, compound wall, sump and interiors are quoted separately. On the narrowest streets the access premium is substantial, and demolition and debris removal take longer. We list both separately so you can see exactly what the street adds.

faqs.question: Who approves a house plan in Purasawalkam?
faqs.answer: For a typical individual house in Purasawalkam, the building permit comes from the Greater Chennai Corporation; larger buildings go to CMDA. On plots with a commercial history, confirm the permitted use first, since it decides what the drawings can show.

faqs.question: Do you get a structural opinion before quoting a shared-wall site?
faqs.answer: Yes. Whether the wall is genuinely shared, whether it carries load from next door and what happens to the neighbouring house if it goes can change the whole approach, so we get a structural engineer’s answer before pricing.

faqs.question: How is material delivered on a street with no vehicle access?
faqs.answer: By hand. Material is dropped at the nearest access point and carried in, concrete is mixed on site in small batches, and debris leaves the same way. It is slower, and we say so at quoting stage rather than later.

faqs.question: Should I plan for extra floors on a small Purasawalkam plot?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plots are small and setbacks take proportionally more, so most projects go up. Our structural drawings size the foundation for the final floor count from the start, because strengthening footings later inside a constrained site is difficult and expensive.
